{{Top}}
The '''Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] manufacturer company. [[Martinique Desler]] was one of the founders of the company, and developed the [[Explorer (landspeeder)|Explorer]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] that many later Desler models were derived from while working for [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. During the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] it produced vehicles for hostile backwater [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. But after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] it rose from relative obscurity by securing contracts to produce air vehicles to replace those lost during the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. By the time [[Darth Krayt]] took over the control over the [[Fel Empire|Empire]], the company has risen significantly in both power and prominence, catering the wealthy elite on [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] such as Coruscant.
